claim_a: F0019 §10 Q2: 'AND THE FALSIFIABLE CORRELATION: all nine rediscoveries drew on UNINDEXED regions. Not one drew on an indexed region.'
claim_b: F0019 revision banner: 'What is REFUTED: §10's "all nine rediscoveries drew on UNINDEXED regions" correlation. Occurrence #10 drew on an INDEXED region that .claude/CLAUDE.md names explicitly. The cause is not only a missing index — it is also not reading the index that exists.'
resolution_basis: The file refutes its own headline correlation in an annotation added after authoring. Both texts are preserved in place; neither was deleted.
historical_treatment: BOTH_STAND. §29: the original correlation was historically asserted and is part of the record; the refutation is a later event, not a retroactive erasure.
significance_reason: The author stated a FALSIFIABLE correlation and then falsified it themselves within the same document. This is the corpus's strongest instance of the epistemic discipline the protocol is trying to reconstruct - and it also changes the corpus's central causal claim from 'missing index' to 'missing index OR unread index'.
